title: No constructor from JMAP form-token string to HeaderForm; every caller reimplements the match
description:
header_typed.rs:126-149 defines `HeaderForm` as the "form-token from a JMAP `header:<name>:as<form>` property selector, normalised to an enum" (per line 128-129 doc).

The crate provides:
- HeaderForm variants matching the JMAP form-tokens (`asAddresses`, `asGroupedAddresses`, `asMessageIds`, `asDate`, `asURLs`, `Raw`)
- No `impl FromStr for HeaderForm` or `impl TryFrom<&str> for HeaderForm`
- No `HeaderForm::from_jmap(s: &str) -> Option<HeaderForm>`
- No `HeaderForm::as_jmap(&self) -> &'static str`

Every JMAP server consuming this crate will have to write its own string→HeaderForm match and the inverse for outgoing responses. That match is non-trivial: the JMAP wire form is `"asAddresses"` (camelCase, leading "as"), not `"Addresses"`; and `Raw` maps to a special form selector (not "asRaw"). Each downstream implementer will reinvent it and likely diverge in edge cases (case-folding? handling of unknown tokens?).

Caller-facing consequence: the crate publishes a JMAP-shaped enum but stops short of the wire-format conversion. Defensive code at every JMAP-aware call site duplicates the same match.

Cite: RFC 8621 §1.4 explicitly registers the form names as `"asText"` ... wait — RFC 8621 §4.1.2 uses `asRaw`, `asText`, `asAddresses`, `asGroupedAddresses`, `asMessageIds`, `asDate`, `asURLs`. The crate omits `asText` from HeaderForm entirely. (That is a separate concern — note here but file separately if real.)

Fix options:
- Add `impl FromStr for HeaderForm` keyed on the RFC 8621 form-token strings, plus an inverse method.
- Document the JMAP-token correspondence in the HeaderForm doc, so downstream implementers at least have a canonical string to use.

This is P3 because the workaround (write your own match) is mechanical. But the crate is explicitly named after RFC 8621 form selectors; the omission is conspicuous.

Line refs:
- header_typed.rs:126-149 — HeaderForm enum, with doc explicitly referencing JMAP form-tokens.
- header_typed.rs:128-129 — doc claims "form-token from a JMAP ... property selector, normalised to an enum" but provides no normalisation function.
close_reason: Added: (.13) six per-form entry points — parse_raw, parse_addresses, parse_grouped_addresses, parse_message_ids, parse_date, parse_urls — each returns the variant payload type directly, eliminating boilerplate match-on-variant at every call site. The sum-type parse_header_typed remains for callers that dispatch dynamically. (.27) HeaderForm now has impl Display emitting the RFC 8621 §4.1.2 form-tokens (asRaw, asAddresses, asGroupedAddresses, asMessageIds, asDate, asURLs), impl FromStr accepting that exact set with a new UnknownHeaderForm error type, and an as_jmap_token() method. asText is intentionally rejected by FromStr until MIME-o2c.28 lands.
